build.description: Tauri desktop build. The ^build dependency reaches @repo/web through the workspace devDependency in package.json (issue #516), so Turbo builds the web bundle that src-tauri/tauri.conf.json frontendDist points at before `tauri build` runs; knip ignores that devDependency because no TypeScript imports it. Rust artifacts under the repo-root .cargo-target (root .cargo/config.toml) are managed by Cargo's own incremental cache and are intentionally not declared as Turbo outputs, so this task opts out of Turbo caching to avoid restoring a stale or absent binary on a cache hit.

bundle.description: Tauri installers for this OS (tauri.conf.json bundle.targets "all": deb, rpm and AppImage on Linux; app and dmg on macOS; nsis and msi on Windows) under the repo-root .cargo-target/release/bundle. Same web dependency edge and no Turbo caching as build.

format:check.description: cargo fmt for src-tauri reads the root rustfmt.toml and toolchain pin; prettier reads the shared config. Clippy and the Rust tests need the WebKitGTK stack, so the PR Rust Checks job runs them, not this workspace.
